contentText: A Russian oil tanker is poised to deliver some much-needed crude oil to Cuba. The Anatoly Kolodkin is expected to dock in the western port of Matanzas imminently, according to shipping tracker MarineTraffic. This comes after Donald Trump appears to have reversed the US blockade of the island nation. Following the US' arrest of Nicolas Maduro, Havana had found itself increasingly isolated, with Washington upping the pressure.
